rationale: Minimize diesel active cost by maximizing inverter active output to its availability limit (p_inverter = 20 MW), giving p_diesel = 34 - 20 = 14 MW. Set q_diesel to preferred 4 Mvar, so q_inverter = 12 - 4 = 8 Mvar. Inverter check: 20^2 + 8^2 = 464 <= 24^2 = 576. Voltage = 0.965 + 0.0025*(4+8) = 0.995 pu, within [0.95, 1.05]. Cost = 14*76 + |4-4|*3 = 1064.
